• Consumer: Ford's core profit ticked higher with guidance raised. Chipotle rose 7% on continued same-store sales growth, and Sprouts plunged on traffic decline.
• Other: Expand Energy curbs some gas output. Ferrovial plans a $23.1B I-285 East concession. Israel's election remains deadlocked.
